verdict.rationale: Delegated access is a fair question for a state business-filing agency, which could publish rules for filing agents, attorneys or service companies acting for a business. The evidence pack contains nothing on what third parties may or may not do, on agent or filer roles, or on which signatures must stay personal. The Credit Card/Debit Card Authorization Form is a payment authorization, not a delegation of filing authority, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, exactly what a third party may and may not do on my behalf is published — the authorization forms, the roles, and which signatures stay personal
